signerProposal: Existing physical primary.localhost test passkey, with separate deployment-only approval and executor. No new credential or key export.
gasSelection: After approval and test-only funding, obtain a native RPC estimate for these exact bytes/sender/nonce. Use ceiling(estimate*1.20) only if <= gasLimitCeiling; revalidate immediately before signing. This proposal is not a gas estimate.

fundingProposal.amount: Only the ordinary free faucet allocation, if available within separately approved terms; never buy or bridge real-value tokens.
fundingProposal.fallback: Stop if account connection, terms, CAPTCHA, insufficient funding or unsupported operation needs user action not already approved.

pendingChecks: Explicit user approval of existing passkey use, exact funding action, providers, one bounded deployment and its public data.
Resolve the recorded faucet/provider terms questions, including dRPC's public endpoint versus general account-registration terms, before requesting execution approval; no implicit authorization.
Before execution recheck chain, nonce zero, no deployer account code, unused predicted address and available test funding on both providers. If nonce changes, prepare a new proposal.
Recheck that the locally implemented/tested/reviewed deployment-only executor still matches its pinned source and artifact hashes; registry writer must still reject contract creation.
Native estimate and fresh fees within all stated caps.
After signing validate exact signed envelope; broadcast once; reconcile uncertain submission by locally computed hash without re-signing.
Finalized exact transaction, successful receipt at predicted address and runtime hash verified on both providers.
externalData: Deployer address sent in read-only preflight already. Approval would publish deployer/contract addresses, contract bytes, nonce, gas and transaction hash. No passkey ID, secret, workspace content or recovery locator goes on chain.
laterSeparateApproval: A new chain-bound A/B enrollment and bounded create/commit/recovery exercise follows deployment verification. Existing local enrollment is not migrated or rebound.
